input.quote: 8.2 Exclusivity of Efforts. Prior to the [ * ], neither Ono or its Affiliates, nor Array or its Controlled Affiliates, shall Commercialize in the Ono Territory:
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "hire", "no-hire", "induce", "recruit" and "personnel" return no employee non-solicitation or no-hire restriction anywhere in the Agreement. Article VIII (Certain Covenants) contains only diligence, conflict-of-interest and product exclusivity covenants (Sections 8.1-8.2), and the General Provisions block contains no hiring restriction. The Agreement therefore sits at our preferred position under NOSOLICIT — no non-solicit binds Ono. The Section 8.2 product exclusivity covenant is a commercial non-compete on Competing Products, not a personnel restriction, and is outside the scope of this rule (any concern with it belongs under the exclusivity/non-compete rule, not here). No redline required.
